summary: Turn dashboards and scenarios into rehearsed leadership decisions. Practise decision briefs, session facilitation, and follow-up planning. Explore the course.
lede: Data storytelling and decision theatre help senior managers, FP&A teams, BI leaders and PMO heads turn KPI evidence into structured leadership choices. The training covers checking dashboard evidence, preparing decision briefs and comparing strategic options through scenario planning and Excel sensitivity analysis. Participants also practise facilitating stakeholder discussions and recording decisions, owners and KPI follow-up triggers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who bring data into leadership decisions and need to turn analysis into a well-framed choice, a productive meeting, and a documented follow-up. It suits people with working familiarity with organizational KPIs, dashboards, or planning processes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational KPIs, dashboards, or financial and operational reports is expected. No coding or programming is required; spreadsheet familiarity will support the Excel scenario exercises.
